referents.why: 'Your waves' (second person): the one addressed is the sea, which the speech commands. The sea is not offered as a candidate.
Implied first person subject of 'I said': the LORD. Not in this verse's candidate list.
Implied second person 'you may come': the sea, addressed in the speech; not a candidate.
Implied second person 'you will add': the same addressee, the sea.
Impersonal third masculine singular 'here someone will fix': the text names no agent for the stopping.

links.why: The words are the content of 'I said', not an event after it; this link reverses the speech. Replaced by a content link.
'I said' introduces the speech; the said clause is cl1 ('you may come this far').
The waw joins 'you may come this far' to 'you will not add': the sense is 'but no farther', a contrast marked by waw and negation.
links.category: waw with negation read as but

links.why: A waw joining a clause to what the limit brings about is a result, not a plain and.
'You shall not go further, and so here your proud waves must stop': the stopping is what the limit brings about.

groups.why: The builder's sender 'cl0s' is a slot; the speaker is the LORD. The addressee, the sea, is not a candidate, so none is given.

none_fit.what: 'But no farther' contrast by waw and negation. The contrast type needs the connective 'ulam' (but), which is absent here.

cant_tell.what: Who sets the limit in cl3 ('here someone will fix').
cant_tell.why: The verb is impersonal and no agent is named.

cant_tell.what: The addressee of the declaration ('you'), the sea.
The LORD is not in this verse's candidate list.
cant_tell.why: Chosen from the speech, as in 38:8.
